original_test_intent: Verify every SMBIOS Type 27 Cooling Device structure, including its device identity/type/status, cooling-unit group, nominal speed and referenced temperature probe, against the approved platform specification.
original_method: Collect complete raw Type 27 and the minimal referenced Type 28 handle inventory through protected read-only access, decode every cooling-device field, verify handle associations and compare to the expected topology without changing fan or thermal control.
manual_activity: The platform/thermal owner supplies the cooling-device topology, expected Type 28 associations and field semantics; an operator verifies target identity and protected access while automation performs the complete comparison.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/board, BIOS and SMBIOS version
Expected Type 27 handles, descriptions, device types and status values
Expected temperature-probe handles, cooling-unit groups and OEM fields
Expected nominal speeds, units, precision and Unknown/not-provided semantics
Supported dmidecode/parser version and raw handle mapping
Protected credential/host verification, redaction and evidence storage
safety_requirements: Keep collection read-only; do not alter fan curves, PWM, thermal thresholds, BIOS or BMC cooling policy
Do not clear logs before relevant baseline evidence is retained
Never put passwords on the command line or disable host-key verification
Capture complete raw stdout/stderr and exit status; no heading-only grep verdict
Verify every non-sentinel temperature-probe reference resolves to the expected Type 28 handle
Do not treat nominal speed metadata as live RPM or fan health
Stop on malformed data, dangling handles or ambiguous units and require owner interpretation
agent_execution_scope: Validate target and expected Type 27 topology
Collect complete raw `dmidecode --type 27` and referenced Type 28 handles through protected access
Parse every cooling device, type/status, group, OEM and speed field
Verify handle referential integrity and expected one-to-one or grouped relationships
Optionally correlate separately labelled read-only fan/thermal telemetry
Report topology and field comparison without mutation or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve cooling-device inventory, probe mapping, speed and sentinel semantics
Resolve absent, duplicate, OEM or dangling associations
Define whether supplemental live fan/thermal evidence is required
Review evidence and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Type 27 selector matches the source, but grep hides fields and associations, while sshpass plus disabled host checking exposes credentials and weakens target identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected authenticated access to run unfiltered `dmidecode --type 27`, retain complete output/status and also read referenced Type 28 handles so every temperature-probe association can be validated.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Type 27 scope, SPEC comparison, private script and 10/10-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: TYPE27 COOLING TOPOLOGY AND HANDLE MATRIX REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a handle-indexed cooling topology that decodes each Type 27 record and resolves its temperature-probe handle against Type 28 before comparing device type/status/group/speed fields with SPEC.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds referential-integrity validation, complete multi-device fields, secure target binding and metadata-versus-live telemetry separation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A Cooling Device heading cannot reveal missing fans, swapped probe associations, dangling handles or incorrect nominal speed.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS cooling records are inventory metadata and may not mirror current fan presence/RPM; live evidence must be reported separately and cannot replace structure validation.

project_override_considerations: If the Project expects no Type 27 records or sentinel probe handles, that must be explicit in the topology matrix. BMC fan inventory is supplemental unless equivalence to SMBIOS handles is approved.
expected_evidence: SUT/BIOS/SMBIOS/parser identity, timestamp and approved Type 27 topology
Complete raw Type 27 stdout/stderr and exit status plus referenced Type 28 handles
Parsed descriptions, device types/status, probe handles, groups, OEM and nominal speeds
Separately labelled optional live fan/thermal correlation plus no-mutation/security audit
Engineer-owned PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently target SMBIOS Type 27 Cooling Device information. Missing topology and association semantics are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The Type 27 collection and association comparison are deterministic once the cooling topology and parser policy are supplied.

review_improvement: Retains the correct Type 27 read while adding complete fields, Type 28 handle integrity, protected identity and separation from live fan telemetry.
independent_technical_reasoning: A cooling record is relational: its probe-handle reference says which temperature source governs or describes the device. Field values can look valid while pointing to the wrong or nonexistent probe, so correct coverage must validate both record contents and cross-handle topology.
